seoTitle: Free CSS Loader and Spinner Generator (Pure CSS)
metaDescription: Generate pure CSS loading spinners, dots, bars and pulses with your colour, size and speed. HTML and CSS to copy, with preview. Free, in your browser.
intro: Creates a pure-CSS loading indicator: a spinner, dual ring, bouncing dots, bars or a pulse. You choose colour, size and speed and get the HTML and CSS to paste, plus a live preview.
why:
Every app has a moment where it waits for data, and a loading animation tells people that something is happening. Pulling in an icon library or a GIF for that is heavy, and hand-writing the keyframes for a spinner is a copy-and-paste job from old projects.

Pick one of five styles, then set the colour, size and animation speed. The output is a tiny HTML snippet and a CSS block with its own keyframes, no images and no JavaScript. The preview shows it centred on the page. Because loaders are decoration, add an accessible label such as aria-busy or visually hidden text where it matters for screen reader users. The code is built in your browser and nothing is uploaded.
howTo: Choose a type: spinner, dual-ring, dots, bars or pulse.
Pick a colour and set the size and speed.
Copy the HTML and CSS into your page.

faq.q: Does it need JavaScript or images?
faq.a: No. Each loader is a few lines of HTML and CSS keyframes, so it loads instantly, scales cleanly at any size and can be recoloured by changing one value.

faq.q: How do I make it accessible?
faq.a: The animation is purely visual. Add a text alternative, such as an aria-label on the container, a visually hidden "Loading" message or aria-busy on the region being updated.

faq.q: Can I change the speed later?
faq.a: Yes. The duration is a single value in the animation property, in seconds, so you can edit it in the CSS. A lower number makes the animation faster.

faq.q: Why does the size scale the other parts?
faq.a: Border thickness, gaps and dot sizes are calculated as fractions of the size you enter, so the loader keeps its proportions as you make it bigger or smaller.
